Report one condition per model

Source: R/run_status.R
run_status.Rd

Tells, for each model a path covers, whether the results on disk still match the files that produced them. Each model is judged by its latest run (the run with the latest submitted_at for that project file, whatever its state), the same rule as check_completion_status(). Only file content (SHA-256) counts: a changed timestamp with the same content is not a change.

Usage

run_status(path = ".", store = default_store())

Arguments

path

Character vector. Files or directories to report on. Relative paths resolve against the working directory. Defaults to ".".

store

Character scalar. The run store directory (see default_store()). Defaults to default_store(). Nothing is written to it, nor anywhere else.

Value

A data frame with one row per path and model (duplicates removed), with columns:

  • path (character): The path given, absolute and normalised

  • project_file (character): Full path to the model's project file (NA when untracked)

  • run_id (character): The model's latest run (NA if none)

  • condition (character): The most serious condition that applies

  • other_conditions (character): The other conditions that apply, comma-separated, most serious first (NA if none)

  • details (character): Short notes behind the conditions, separated by "; ". A failed or unfinished run's state comes first ("submit failed", "no results", "completion not recorded" or "completion crashed"), then the files, named relative to the folder that holds the store where possible, e.g. "data/pk.csv modified; run1/summary.txt missing"; "recorded late" for "clean_late"; for an untracked path that only older runs recorded, "recorded only by an older run (<run_id>)" naming the most recent of them (NA if none)

  • submitted_at (POSIXct): When the latest run was submitted

  • completed_at (POSIXct): When the latest run completed (NA if not completed)

Details

What path covers:

  • a directory: every .mlxtran, .pkx and .smlx file under it, recursively, one row each (as in check_completion_status());

  • a project file: one row;

  • a file recorded as an input or output of the latest run of some models: one row per such model;

  • any other existing file: one row with condition "untracked".

A path that does not exist and is not recorded in the store is an error.

Conditions, most serious first:

  1. "never_run": no run of the model is recorded.

  2. "untracked_results": results exist in the model's output folder but no recorded run produced them, e.g. a run from the GUI or lixoftConnectors.

  3. "failed": the latest run failed to submit or finished without results.

  4. "unfinished": the latest run's completion was not recorded, or recording it crashed.

  5. "inputs_changed": the project file or a recorded input of the latest run has different content or is missing. Monolix library models (lib:) never count.

  6. "output_edited": a recorded output of the latest run has different content or is missing.

  7. "output_suspect": an unchanged recorded output was flagged when the latest run's completion was recorded late.

  8. "clean_late": the latest run was recorded late and nothing above applies.

  9. "clean": nothing above applies.

  10. "untracked": the path is not a model, nor a file recorded by the latest run of any model.

See also
